info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Business Service By Business Id-spec
info.description: The Business Service Retrieval API enables users to access detailed information about specific business services by their unique business ID. This API is essential for developers building applications that require business service insights or management capabilities. Typical consumers include internal applications, business analysts, and third-party integrations that need real-time access to business service data. By using this endpoint, users can streamline their operations and enhance service offerings based on accurate business information.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific business by its ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a business using its unique identifier. It can be used to access various attributes and metadata associated with the specified business.
